tools.name: get_league_commentary
tools.description: Read Fantasy Pundit’s existing canonical weekly commentary and roast for a public FPL mini-league. Use this first for requests to roast, recap, or review a league. It never creates a new edition. At full-time it can report that the current Gameweek is available to reserve while FPL scoring settles.

league.description: A public FPL classic league ID, a Fantasy Premier League league URL, or a league name search term. If the user has not provided one, ask them for it before calling this tool.

gameweek.description: Optional Gameweek from 1 to 38. Omit for the current available Gameweek.

tools.name: generate_weekly_commentary
tools.description: Create, reserve, or reuse Fantasy Pundit’s one official weekly commentary and league roast for the current available Gameweek. At full-time, a request can be saved and starts automatically as soon as FPL scoring is ready, which may be before FPL changes its public Gameweek label. This can consume shared generation capacity, so call it only after the user explicitly asks. Repeated calls return the same canonical league/Gameweek job. There are no tone or audio controls.

league.description: A public FPL classic league ID, a Fantasy Premier League league URL, or a league name search term. If the user has not provided one, ask them for it before calling this tool.

gameweek.description: Expected current Gameweek from the read or failed job. Refuses creation if the available week changed; cannot create historical editions.

tools.name: get_commentary_result
tools.description: Check a Fantasy Pundit weekly commentary and league-roast job returned by generate_weekly_commentary. It never starts generation. When completed, return the exact canonical commentary and share links without rewriting it.

jobId.description: Weekly commentary job ID returned by generate_weekly_commentary.
